title: USF-186 Operator Access and Gateway Posture Matrix
scope: Lane 2 only: operator/admin service access posture, gateway and clickthrough boundaries, admin-surface exposure policy, authn/authz posture, audit evidence, break-glass relevance, and no-public-exposure non-claims.
adminSurfaceExposurePolicy: No public or LAN exposure is authorised by this lane. Local host-published operator/admin/control-plane surfaces remain loopback-only, and provider consoles remain external-provider-managed unless a later accepted authority changes the boundary.
authnAuthzPosture: Each operator/admin/gateway/provider-console surface requires an explicit service-catalogue access decision, owner, auth requirement, authorization boundary, audit requirement, break-glass relevance, and non-claim boundary before stronger readiness.
tenantBoundary: Tenant isolation for operator/admin access is not proven by this matrix and must be proven before stronger readiness claims.
secretBoundary: Evidence and routes must use secret references only; no raw credentials, tokens, connection strings, or provider payloads are allowed in evidence.

gatewayBoundary.authnAuthzPosture: defined-only; future route and clickthrough implementation must fail closed and preserve service-catalogue access decisions
gatewayBoundary.auditPosture: operator-action-audit-required for gateway-mediated operator/admin actions before stronger readiness

clickthroughBoundary: No UI or clickthrough implementation is created by USF-186. Future clickthrough must inherit gateway authn/authz and audit posture before test or operator readiness.
proofPosture: USF-169 adds hermetic API operator-access proof for provider posture and observability posture surfaces via corepack pnpm proof:operator-access. The proof exercises missing tenant, tenant mismatch, PDP denial, security-admin permit, redacted provider views, observability readiness/signals, audit evidence, and security signals. Composed service console login, gateway clickthrough UX, executed periodic access reviews, public exposure, staging, production, and live-provider operator access remain unproven and deferred.

changeManagementEvidence.changeRecord: USF-186 PR evidence and validator output
changeManagementEvidence.rollbackBoundary: Revert the matrix and validator rule; no runtime, UI, provider, or public route state is created by this lane.
changeManagementEvidence.deferredBoundary: Gateway route proof, operator clickthrough UX, composed service console login, executed periodic access reviews, deprovisioning workflow evidence, and public/LAN/staging/production/live-provider operator access remain deferred.

accessReviewDeprovisioningBoundary.boundary: USF-217 records current access-review and deprovisioning posture for the selected closure tier. Executed recurring review, provider-console revocation, identity lifecycle integration, and stronger operator readiness remain deferred to USF-221.

adr0015AuthorisedExposures.summary: ADR 0015 authorises a single edge-authenticated (Caddy HTTP basic authentication) reverse-proxy exposure of the /proof staging proof cockpit at https://1e100.network/proof on the staging host only. The staging-proof-cockpit service port stays loopback-only; there is no direct public host port. The /proof cockpit route is never imported on the aldous.info production host. All platform non-claims are preserved and the reachable operator fixture is not a platform go-live.
